description: Search every page on the Bay Area Mobile Dog Wash website by keyword and get back real URLs. Use this whenever the customer asks something get_services does not cover — a specific breed, a coat or skin problem (matting, shedding, fleas, skunk, itchy skin, anxious or senior dogs), a city, or a price comparison. Cite the returned URL rather than guessing. If nothing relevant comes back, say we do not have a page on it instead of inventing one.

limit.description: How many pages to return (default 6, max 12).

query.description: What the customer wants to know, in their own words, e.g. 'matted goldendoodle', 'husky shedding', 'skunk smell', 'do you serve Cupertino', 'nail trim cost'.

name: find_page
